text:
toni: seeing a sprout of support tickets from new signups: streaming session drops around token refresh and clients sometimes get repeated terminal events. repro on web + android sampleapps.
li: hmm. any logs or a repro snippet?
toni: minimal repro: open onboarding sampleapp -> start streaming chat -> wait ~30s (our refresh is jittered to 30s for tests). sometimes connection drops then reconnects and the UI shows two \"[DONE]\" frames. logs: 
```
[2026-03-21T09:10:01Z] sse: connected (conn=0x7f)
[2026-03-21T09:10:31Z] auth: refresh triggered
[2026-03-21T09:10:31Z] sse: recv event: id=987 data=\"...\"
[2026-03-21T09:10:31Z] sse: connection closed (unexpected)
[2026-03-21T09:10:31Z] client: reconnecting with last_event_id=987
[2026-03-21T09:10:31Z] sse: recv event: id=987 data=\"...\" // duplicate terminal
```
marcus: sounds like resume and final-chunk emission overlap. Do sampleapps set `retry: 0` or custom SSE headers? Android stream lib had a bug where it replays the last buffer after reconnect if `Content-Length` was misread.
li: on web sampleapp we call `xhr.abort()` at refresh start; android uses keep-alive and finishes. so parity mismatch again.
toni: right. two problems: (1) abort-vs-wait causes different failure modes, (2) dedupe logic on client is weak so duplicates surface to UX.
support-bot: incoming tickets: #4521, #4523 mentioning duplicate DONE tokens.
marcus: proposed fixes:
- change web sampleapp to avoid abort on refresh; instead attach an auth-refresh header to the next connect so server resumes cleanly.
- add client-side dedupe: ignore events with identical event ids for 3s window and treat them as idempotent. fallback to a short checksum if id not present.
- update android lib to normalize last-event-id semantics to match web.
- add an onboarding blurb: \"Streams may briefly reconnect while refreshing credentials; the app will resume and dedupe repeated messages.\"
li: we should also add telemetry: counter for `sse_resume_duplicate` + sdk tag so we can see which platforms are most affected.
marcus: also check server behavior: ensure resume handshake is atomic w.r.t final event emission. if server sends final chunk and then processes resume, it might replay. I'll open a server ticket.
toni: can we make the sampleapp less chatty while we iterate? maybe mask repeated DONE frames in UI.
li: yes, UI change small. i'll do that and ship as patch.
marcus: I'll submit small PRs: android sdk parity change + unit test that forces a refresh mid-stream; web sampleapp change + e2e that asserts only one terminal event rendered.
devops-bot: staging deploy queued for branch/silent-sse-reconnect-fix 99% checks passing, rollout scheduled in 8m.
toni: great. follow-ups:
- client dedupe impl in both SDKs
- sampleapp UX blurb + README note
- telemetry metric + dashboards
- server ticket to validate resume atomicity

support-bot: tagging internal KB: kb/streaming-onboarding-duplicate-done. recommended answer drafted.
li: thanks team. let's watch staging for regression and keep the support KB up-to-date.
toni: closing for now; will re-open if staging/metrics disagree. :white_check_mark:
